global_style: An elegant, editorial-style template featuring a muted Morandi color palette, extreme typographic contrast, and minimalist geometric image framing.

identity_anchors: Persistent thin-line 'navigation' header and footer across most slides
Extreme contrast between oversized serif display text and tiny sans-serif body copy
Solid color offset blocks behind images serving as pseudo drop-shadows
Boxed text treatments with delicate 1px borders

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
